description: This file defines the Config class in the Todaymade\Daux namespace, which extends BaseConfig. It manages configuration settings for the documentation generator, including retrieval and setting of various configuration options like title, author, theme, language, mode, cache, and other related settings. It also provides methods to obtain specific configuration objects such as ConfluenceConfig and HTMLConfig, and handles internal state related to the documentation build.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class managing configuration data for the documentation generator, including accessors and mutators for various configuration options, dependencies on other configuration objects, and internal state management.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the documentation title from configuration.

methods.name: hasAuthor
methods.description: Checks if author information is set.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves the author information from configuration.

methods.name: hasTagline
methods.description: Checks if a tagline is set.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Returns the current page content object.

methods.name: setCurrentPage
methods.description: Sets the current page content object.

methods.name: isMultilanguage
methods.description: Determines if project supports multiple languages.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns the list of supported languages.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode (live or static).

methods.name: shouldInheritIndex
methods.description: Determines if index inheritance is enabled.

methods.name: getIndexKey
methods.description: Returns the key for index page based on mode.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Returns the theme object if set.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on current configuration.

methods.name: hasTranslationKey
methods.description: Checks if a translation string exists for a specific language and key.

methods.name: getTranslationKey
methods.description: Retrieves a translation string for a specific language and key.

methods.name: hasImage
methods.description: Checks if an image is configured.

methods.name: hasEntryPage
methods.description: Checks if an entry page is configured.

methods.name: hasRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request configuration exists.

methods.name: hasProcessorInstance
methods.description: Checks if a processor instance exists.

methods.name: hasHost
methods.description: Checks if host configuration is set.
